source_title: St Johnstone fan views on 2-2 draw with Motherwell - BBC
source_excerpt:
We asked for your views after St Johnstone drew 2-2 at home to Motherwell.
Neil : While we obviously must concentrate on picking up three points at home, the team has continued with a very healthy habit of picking up points while under the cosh and looking defeated - something which just wasn't happening in the last few seasons in the Premiership. Those points will be vital at the end of the campaign.
Gordon : We totally mugged Motherwell. We only got our goals when we cut out the tippy-tappy sideways and backwards stuff. We have good players but Simo needs to let them play and stop over coaching them.
Ray: I was watching the match in bed and was gutted when Motherwell went in front. I fell asleep and was delighted when I woke up this morning to see we had equalised with the last kick of the game.
